scope: Walcha councillor vacancy and council endorsement of a preferred by-election date.

sources.title: Walcha Council 28 October draft ordinary meeting minutes
sources.finding: The General Manager relayed NSWEC’s preferred date. Council voted unanimously to endorse 16 January 2027.

sources.title: Walcha Council minutes index
sources.finding: The Council lists the 28 October document as draft minutes.

sources.title: Walcha Council resignation statement
sources.finding: Adam Iuston resigned effective 23 October 2026. The earlier evidence remains separately recorded.
